   AND (f.monthly_volume IS NULL OR f.monthly_volume = '100k-1m')
   AND (f.monthly_fraud_level IS NULL OR f.monthly_fraud_level = '>8.3%')

per_tx AS (
  SELECT psp_reference, eur_amount, COUNT(*) AS n_match,
    ARRAY_AGG(STRUCT(ID, fixed_amount, rate) ORDER BY ID LIMIT 1)[OFFSET(0)] AS r

WITH tx AS (

    (issuing_country = acquirer_country) AS is_intra,

),
mstats AS (
  SELECT mo, SUM(eur_amount) AS vol,
    SUM(IF(has_fraudulent_dispute, eur_amount, 0)) / SUM(eur_amount) * 100 AS fraud_pct
  FROM tx GROUP BY mo
),
tx2 AS (
  SELECT t.*, s.vol, s.fraud_pct,
    CASE WHEN s.vol < 100000 THEN '<100k' WHEN s.vol < 1000000 THEN '100k-1m'
         WHEN s.vol <= 5000000 THEN '1m-5m' ELSE '>5m' END AS vol_bucket,
    CASE WHEN s.fraud_pct < 7.2 THEN '<7.2%' WHEN s.fraud_pct <= 7.7 THEN '7.2%-7.7%'
         WHEN s.fraud_pct <= 8.3 THEN '7.7%-8.3%' ELSE '>8.3%' END AS fraud_bucket
  FROM tx t JOIN mstats s USING (mo)
),
matched AS (
  SELECT t.psp_reference, t.eur_amount, f.ID AS rule_id,
    f.fixed_amount + f.rate * t.eur_amount / 10000 AS fee
  FROM tx2 t
  LEFT JOIN `<gcp-project>.dabstep.fees` f
    ON (f.card_scheme IS NULL OR f.card_scheme = t.card_scheme)
   AND (f.is_credit IS NULL OR f.is_credit = t.is_credit)
   AND (f.aci IS NULL OR t.aci IN UNNEST(f.aci))

),

)

  SUM(avg_fee) AS sum_avg_fee, SUM(min_fee) AS sum_min_fee, SUM(max_fee) AS sum_max_fee

WITH tx AS (
  SELECT psp_reference, eur_amount, card_scheme, is_credit, aci,
    (issuing_country = acquirer_country) AS is_intra,
    EXTRACT(MONTH FROM DATE_ADD(DATE '2023-01-01', INTERVAL day_of_year - 1 DAY)) AS mo,
    has_fraudulent_dispute
  FROM `<gcp-project>.dabstep.payments`
  WHERE merchant = 'Martinis_Fine_Steakhouse' AND year = 2023
),
mstats AS (
  SELECT mo, SUM(eur_amount) AS vol,
    SUM(IF(has_fraudulent_dispute, eur_amount, 0)) / SUM(eur_amount) * 100 AS fraud_pct
  FROM tx GROUP BY mo
),
tx2 AS (
  SELECT t.*, s.vol, s.fraud_pct,
    CASE WHEN s.vol < 100000 THEN '<100k' WHEN s.vol < 1000000 THEN '100k-1m'
         WHEN s.vol <= 5000000 THEN '1m-5m' ELSE '>5m' END AS vol_bucket,
    CASE WHEN s.fraud_pct < 7.2 THEN '<7.2%' WHEN s.fraud_pct <= 7.7 THEN '7.2%-7.7%'
         WHEN s.fraud_pct <= 8.3 THEN '7.7%-8.3%' ELSE '>8.3%' END AS fraud_bucket
  FROM tx t JOIN mstats s USING (mo)
),
matched AS (
  SELECT t.psp_reference, f.ID AS rule_id,
    f.fixed_amount + f.rate * t.eur_amount / 10000 AS fee
  FROM tx2 t
  LEFT JOIN `<gcp-project>.dabstep.fees` f
    ON (f.card_scheme IS NULL OR f.card_scheme = t.card_scheme)
   AND (f.is_credit IS NULL OR f.is_credit = t.is_credit)
   AND (f.aci IS NULL OR ARRAY_LENGTH(f.aci) = 0 OR t.aci IN UNNEST(f.aci))
   AND (f.intracountry IS NULL OR f.intracountry = IF(t.is_intra, 1, 0))
   AND (f.account_type IS NULL OR ARRAY_LENGTH(f.account_type) = 0 OR 'H' IN UNNEST(f.account_type))
   AND (f.merchant_category_code IS NULL OR ARRAY_LENGTH(f.merchant_category_code) = 0 OR 5812 IN UNNEST(f.merchant_category_code))
   AND (f.capture_delay IS NULL OR f.capture_delay = 'immediate')
   AND (f.monthly_volume IS NULL OR f.monthly_volume = t.vol_bucket)
   AND (f.monthly_fraud_level IS NULL OR f.monthly_fraud_level = t.fraud_bucket)
),
per_tx AS (
  SELECT psp_reference, COUNT(rule_id) AS n_rules, AVG(fee) AS avg_fee, MIN(fee) AS min_fee, MAX(fee) AS max_fee
  FROM matched GROUP BY psp_reference
)
SELECT n_rules, COUNT(*) AS txns,
  ROUND(SUM(avg_fee), 2) AS sum_avg_fee, ROUND(SUM(min_fee), 2) AS sum_min_fee, ROUND(SUM(max_fee), 2) AS sum_max_fee
